frames.label: Frame 1 - Igniting Excellence as a Premier Engineering School in the Philippines
frames.f2_title: Igniting Excellence as a Premier Engineering School in the Philippines
frames.f2_content: Mapúa University, founded in 1925 by Don Tomas Mapúa, is a world-class higher education institution in the Philippines dedicated to providing a learning environment rooted in discipline, excellence, commitment, integrity, and relevance. Recognized by the 2025  Times Higher Education (THE) World University Rankings (WUR) as one of the best schools in the world, our academic stronghold provides a diverse array of programs grounded in engineering and science, architecture and design, information technology, business and health sciences, and media studies. Our goal is to foster an atmosphere that promotes academic rigor and practical expertise, enabling students to compete on a global scale. And with strong moral fibers and first-rate abilities, our graduates are ready to make a difference in the world.

frames.label: Frame 2 - Be a Part of the Groundbreaking Academic Success
frames.f1_title: Be a Part of the Groundbreaking Academic Success
frames.f1_content:
Highly regarded as an engineering and technological institution in the Philippines, Mapúa provides a comprehensive curriculum for senior high school students, undergraduates, graduates, and those interested in fully online programs.

A world-class education is at the heart of every degree and program, ensuring students are well-prepared to compete on a global scale. The university's rigorous academic program emphasizes practical skills and character development to position students for industry leadership and environmental stewardship. Explore your options today and join one of the many programs offered by Mapúa University.

sliders.title: Undergraduate
sliders.content: Topnotch bachelor's degrees in various fields are offered at the University. The programs feature cutting-edge learning as students maximize Mapúa's digtal learning tools and state-of-the-art campus facilities.

sliders.title: Graduate
sliders.content: Mapúa University offers an exceptional range of advanced Master's and Doctorate degrees that are meticulously designed to foster continuous education and provide access to world-class learning opportunities.

sliders.title: Fully Online
sliders.content: Programs that cater to the needs of distant learners and working professionals. These programs offer the ideal solution for individuals who value flexibility and the freedom to learn anywhere, at their own pace.

sliders.title: Senior High School
sliders.content: All four strands of the Academic Track are offered at Mapúa: Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM), General Academic Strand (GAS), Humanities and Social Sciences (HUMSS), and Accountancy, Business, and Management (ABM). Mapúa also offers Arts and Design Track for students who are into creative pursuits.

frames.label: Frame 6 - Partnership
frames.f4_title: Access high-quality international education in business, health sciences, nursing, and medicine
frames.f4_content: Through our collaboration with Arizona State University, the #1 in the US for innovation, students are provided access to highly differentiated education in business, health sciences, nursing, and medicine, providing global immersion and readiness, advanced and immersive facilities, real-world experiential learning, and digital mastery.

frames.label: Frame 3 - 98 years of cutting-edge education
frames.f3_content:
Standing 100 years strong, Mapúa is an institution of excellence recognized as one of the world’s best universities and the Philippines’ premier engineering and technological school. A key innovator, Mapúa continues to be a leader in education by expanding its presence in different fields of study like Communication and Media Studies, Business and Management, Health Sciences, as well as integrating Senior High School, successfully developing and implementing diverse curricula that contribute to the advancement of the nation and the world.

Home of the nation’s top builders and creators, Mapúa celebrates its 100th year as an education leader with global competence, reflected beyond its consistent international rankings and accreditations from esteemed bodies and through a century of its endeavors to champion an accessible and quality education for all—upholding the vision Don Tomas Mapúa began 100 years ago. 

 

With this vision realized, we commemorate the institution’s historic milestone with the entire Mapúan community and its subsidiaries Mapúa Malayan Colleges Laguna, Mapúa Malayan Colleges Mindanao, and Mapúa Malayan Digital College, in a month-long full of centennial-related activities that will surely ignite their red and gold spirit.

news.title: Mapúa Nursing Student Wins 1st Place in an International Essay Competition
news.content_introduction: Mapúa University School of Nursing student Mikaella Fhaye Perlado, a second-year BS Nursing student, earned 1st Place in the International Essay Competition during the 18th Dies Natalis of Esa Unggul University last September 11, 2026.
news.author: Mapúa University

news.title: Mapúa Education Group, Arizona State University® launch groundbreaking academic partnership to globalize Philippine higher education
news.content_introduction: Mapúa Education Group and Arizona State University (ASU) today announced the expansion of their groundbreaking academic partnership to globalize Philippine higher education.
news.author: Mapúa University

news.title: Mapúa Education Group Introduces ChatGPT Edu – A first for Philippine Education
news.content_introduction: The Mapúa Education Group (MEG) announced its historic group-wide collaboration with OpenAI for the roll out ChatGPT Edu to its students and educators across the Philippines.

news.title: Capcom Singapore Collaborates with Mapúa University to Deliver Intellectual Property and Business Education Program in the Philippines
news.content_introduction: Capcom Singapore has partnered with Mapúa University and Prime Manpower to develop an innovative educational program themed around ‘Games, Intellectual Property & Digital Culture.’

news.title: Mapúa and MMSU Spearhead Offshore Wind Workforce Revolution in Landmark Partnership with BENLC
news.content_introduction: Mapúa University signed a Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) with Buhawind Energy Northern Luzon Corporation (BENLC) and Mariano Marcos State University (MMSU) for Northern Luzon Offshore Wind Power Project.

news.title: Mapúa Honored with AI Innovation Award: A Century of Excellence Leads the Digital Frontier
news.content_introduction: Mapúa University was awarded the prestigious 2025 Coursera Outstanding Achievement Award in the Artificial Intelligence (AI) Innovation category.

news.title: Mapúa University redefines hospitality education with the launch of innovation-led School of Tourism and Hospitality Management
news.content_introduction: Mapúa University has officially launched its innovation-led School of Tourism and Hospitality Management (STHM), consisting of an AI-integrated curriculum.

news.title: Mastering Math and Science: Mapúa Senior high school faculty share insights for academic excellence
news.content_introduction:
For many Filipino young learners and their parents, mastering math and science remains a persistent challenge.

This is evident in the country’s subpar performance in the Program for International Student Assessment (PISA) 2022 and Trends in International Mathematics and Science Study (TIMSS) 2019, where students ranked among the lowest in math and science. The results reflect a widespread difficulty with complex problem-solving and applying concepts to real-life situations.

news.title: Mapúa University Hosts Curriculum Summit: A Century of Nation-Building through Education
news.content_introduction: Mapúa University successfully held its annual Alumni and Industry Curriculum Summit on June 20–21, 2025. Hosted by the Innovation and Development Office for Career Advancement and Lifelong Learning (idCALL), the two-day event gathered esteemed alumni, industry leaders, and academic experts to critically examine and redefine the educational curricula. The summit honored Mapúa University’s 100-year legacy while charting a bold path forward for education in the Philippines.

news.title: Mapúa University Boosts Global Standing as an Innovation Powerhouse with WURI 2025 Recognition
news.content_introduction: In an outstanding achievement that further amplifies its position as a global leader in innovation and impact, Mapúa University has secured the 313th spot in the prestigious 2025 World University Rankings for Innovation (WURI) Global Top 400 Innovative Universities. This significant recognition underscores Mapúa's forward-thinking approach to innovation, education, and its profound impact on the community.

news.title: RLIP 2025 Marks Record-Breaking Year for Student Research and International Collaboration at Mapúa University
news.content_introduction: The Research Learning & Immersion Program (RLIP) 2025, an annual initiative by Mapúa University’s Office of International Linkages, Relations, and Development Cooperation (ILRAD), ran from June 9 to 25, gathering 104 senior high school students for two weeks of research training, laboratory immersion, and international collaboration.

news.title: Mapúa Leads AI Integration in Education through INSPIRE
news.content_introduction: Mapúa University is setting the standard in Philippine higher education with its pioneering initiative, INSPIRE—the Innovational Network for Supporting Professional Integration of AI in Education. Spearheaded by the Center for Teaching and Learning (CTL) as part of the University’s broader AI Strategy Roadmap, the INSPIRE project signals a deep institutional commitment to meaningful and ethical AI integration across disciplines.

news.title: Mapúa professor sheds light on advantages of going solar power
news.content_introduction:
With rising electricity becoming a growing concern, Filipinos are turning to renewable energy (RE) for their homes, particularly solar.

While solar power is a very promising solution, Dr. Jaime Honra, program chair of the School of Mechanical, Manufacturing, and Energy Engineering at Mapúa University, emphasized that understanding the right solar power system is key to making a wise and cost-saving investment for Filipino households.

news.title: A Century On, Mapúa Makes Historic QS World University Rankings Debut
news.content_introduction: In a moment that marks a new chapter in its storied legacy, Mapúa University has earned a coveted place in the 2026 QS World University Rankings—one of the most respected and competitive global university ranking systems.

news.title: From Passion to Profession: Support Your Child's Future through Mapúa's BS Game Development Program
news.content_introduction: As kids spend hours online, engrossed in either solving quests or winning matches, it's not unusual for parents to wonder if their child's passion for gaming could lead to something greater. Can gaming be more than just a pastime but a direction? For Mapúa University, the country's leading engineering and technological institution, the answer is a resounding yes. Home to a distinctive BS Game Development program, the institute recognizes gaming's potential as a platform for innovation, education, and collaboration.

news.title: Mapúa University: Embracing inclusivity and diversity to support every student’s journey
news.content_introduction: In keeping with its core mission of providing accessible, high-quality education, Mapúa University has steadfastly championed gender inclusivity and diversity through the university-wide implementation of its Gender Equality and Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Policies.

news.title: Mapúa Cardinal Tech Fest 2025 empowers young innovators to CTRL+CREATE
news.content_introduction: Young tech whizzes from all over Luzon showed off their skills and creativity in engineering, technology, and gaming at the Cardinal Tech Fest 2025 held at the Mapúa Makati Campus last May 31.

news.title: Mapúa launches the country's first Artificial Intelligence Engineering undergrad program
news.content_introduction: In keeping with its mission of building the future, Mapúa University has officially launched a cutting-edge Bachelor of Science in Artificial Intelligence (AI) Engineering degree this academic year, 2025-2026, the first-ever undergraduate program of its kind in the Philippines.

news.title: Philippine Tourism reclaims momentum, Innovative Mapúa tourism programs help drive growth
news.content_introduction: A few years ago, the idea of travelling overseas and exploring distant places seemed an elusive dream. The pandemic didn't just slow tourism down–it was brought to a standstill, grounding airlines and forcing travel bans. Despite these restrictions, the tourism and hospitality industry adapted.

news.title: Mapúa Cardinal Summit leads future innovators, leaders towards academic success
news.content_introduction: Senior high school can be a confusing time for students since they are pressured to make several major life decisions, like choosing a future career and education, while undergoing significant personal and social changes. To help students manage the overwhelm and guide them towards academic success, Mapúa University hosted its annual Mapúa Cardinal Summit, an immersive pre-college event.

news.title: Making a Mark: How Mapúa’s Graduate School Empowered This Innovator to Transform Industries with an Eco-Friendly Invention
news.content_introduction: In a world increasingly grappling with environmental challenges, one MS Materials Science and Engineering by Research student from Mapúa University’s Graduate Studies has revolutionized how industries can commit to upholding sustainability across their operations with his groundbreaking invention, Pili Seal.

news.title: Mapúa breeds next-generation global climate solutionaries
news.content_introduction: The global climate crisis demands science-based sustainable solutions, and Mapúa University is leading the charge as the first Philippine institution to offer a bachelor’s program in energy engineering.

news.title: Mapúa microcredential programs prepare PH workforce for 4IR
news.content_introduction: Mapúa University has introduced microcredential programs to equip the Filipino workforce for the fourth industrial revolution (4IR). As shifting industry demands and technological innovations transform job markets, these quick, focused courses have become essential to ensure career and future readiness.

news.title: iPeople and Coursera expand partnership to deliver AI-powered, future-ready education to 45,000 students
news.content_introduction: Students and faculty gain access to Generative AI tools, industry micro-credentials, and academic credit pathways to build globally competitive skills.

news.title: The truth about cyberattacks and how Mapúa is equipping the next generation of cyber experts
news.content_introduction: Imagine waking up in the morning to find out that you, along with hundreds of other Filipinos, have lost your hard-earned savings overnight because of a perfectly orchestrated cyberattack on your online bank. Although the bank may be able to recover your funds, the fear, wait, and inconvenience during the investigation and processing period can be nightmarish even for those who are well-off. This scenario is just one of the many cybercrimes that could happen here in the country and overseas.

news.title: A New Year and Into the Next Century: Mapúa University highlights a century of achievements in Centennial Year celebrations
news.content_introduction: Mapúa University, the country's premier engineering and technological institution, has culminated its centennial year celebrations with academic and cultural events highlighting the institute's innumerable contributions and impact since its founding in 1925.

news.title: Mapúa Ranked #1 in the Philippines for Engineering, Computer Science, and Physical Sciences in THE-WUR by Subject 2025
news.content_introduction: Mapúa University has once again solidified its position as the leading institution for engineering, technology, and the sciences in the Philippines. In the latest Times Higher Education (THE) World University Rankings (WUR) by Subject 2025, Mapúa has emerged as the #1 university in the country for Engineering, Computer Science, and Physical Sciences, surpassing institutions such as the University of the Philippines (UP), De La Salle University (DLSU), and Ateneo de Manila University (ADMU).

news.title: Mapúa University Celebrates Centennial with ICSET 2025: A Commitment to People and Planet
news.content_introduction: In its centennial year, Mapúa University proudly hosts the International Conference on Sustainable Environmental Technologies (ICSET) 2025 in partnership with National Chung Hsing University at the Manila Hotel from January 21-23, 2025. This prestigious event underscores Mapúa’s enduring commitment to fostering advancements in environmental sustainability and its role as a university for people and planet.

news.title: Mapúa University prepares students for the future of industries with AI integration
news.content_introduction: The public has been divided on the usefulness and risks of artificial Intelligence technologies or AI ever since it broke through the market. However, while some organizations have shied away from AI, progressive higher education institutions like Mapúa University have embraced the technology, knowing that it will reshape and drive industries in the near future.

news.title: Mapúa University and Mapúa MCL soar in global QS Rankings
news.content_introduction: Two Mapúa schools, Mapúa University and Mapúa Malayan Colleges Laguna (Mapúa MCL) continue to elevate Philippine higher education on the global stage, securing impressive rankings in the latest QS Sustainability Rankings and QS Stars ratings. The prestigious QS Stars evaluate institutions globally based on a range of criteria, including academic reputation, faculty quality, research impact, and internationalization, as well as environmental impact, social responsibility, and governance for QS Sustainability.

news.title: Two Mapúa Professors Included in the World's Top 2% Scientists
news.content_introduction: Two Mapúa University faculty members upheld the Mapúan excellence in their recognition by Stanford University and Elsevier as among the World’s Top 2% Scientists for August 2024. The prestigious distinction was bestowed upon Dr. Reggie C. Pantig, a full-time probationary professor from the Department of Physics, and Dr. Ardvin Kester Ong, an associate professor from the School of Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management and program chairman of Engineering Management, for the copious and highly impactful works they have contributed to their respective fields.

news.title: Mapúa opens online applications for A.Y. 2025-2026 with enhanced learning and student experience
news.content_introduction: Getting a world-class education is now within reach as Mapúa University has officially opened its online applications for new college, senior high school, and graduate students for the academic year 2025 to 2026.

news.title: Mapúa Schools Achieve Milestone as the First School System in the PH to Attain Quality Matters Certification
news.content_introduction: The Mapúa Schools, a leading education group in the Philippines, has made history by becoming the first school system in the country to receive certification from Quality Matters (QM). QM is a prestigious global organization that recognizes outstanding online courses, ensuring they meet the highest standards of quality and innovation.

news.title: Mapúa ranks in the 2025 World University Rankings for a third straight year
news.content_introduction: Mapúa University has once again cemented its place among the world's top educational institutions, achieving a remarkable third consecutive ranking in the prestigious Times Higher Education World University Rankings for 2025.

news.title: Breaking Borders: Accessing US Education in the Philippines
news.content_introduction:
The number of US schools collaborating with Filipino universities have increased in recent years. The emergence of these schools has allowed Filipinos to experience world-class education from the comfort of their home country. This development marks a significant shift in the country’s educational standards, offering unprecedented opportunities for aspiring professionals to pursue top-tier degrees without the need to relocate.

Discover how you can acquire a world-class education, expand your career horizons, and gain a competitive edge, all from the comfort of the Philippines.
news.author: Mapúa University

news.title: Mapúa University Revolutionizes Education with Innovative Digital Tools
news.content_introduction: Mapúa University, the country’s premier engineering and technological school, has taken a significant step towards enhancing student experiences and bridging the learning gap by launching four innovative digital toolkits: Ally, EAC Visual Data, Engage, and MapúaX.

news.title: Mapúa University Ushers in a New Era of Innovation with Thought Leadership Program
news.content_introduction: Mapúa University approaches its centennial under the theme "Always Building the Future," it reaffirms its role as the nation’s leading institution in engineering and technology, steadfast in its dedication to innovation and transformative education.

news.title: Mapúa and partner schools arrest learning crisis in PH with ‘Mapúa Snippets,’ a free digital education tool for children
news.content_introduction: Mapúa University, a renowned learning institution in the country and a recognized global leader in education, takes the lead in reversing the depressing learning poverty experienced among many Filipino children by building a free and accessible digital education tool, Mapúa Snippets.

news.title: School of Health Sciences hosts 1st ASU scholar to visit Mapúa
news.content_introduction: MANILA, August 22, 2024 – The School of Health Sciences (SoHS) served host as Mapúa University opened its doors to the first-ever visiting scholar from Arizona State University (ASU) since the two universities partnered in May 11, 2022 through the Cintana Educational Network. Dr. Peter Joseph Torres, Assistant Professor, of ASU’s Department of English arrived in the Philippines for a series of research lecturing and networking activities with administrators, faculty members, and students of Mapúa SoHS from August 15 to 21.
news.author: Mapúa School of Health Sciences

news.title: Mapúa University Empowers Filipino STEM Educators with Free Online CPD Event
news.content_introduction: Reinforcing its leadership in STEM education, Mapúa University (MU), along with Mapúa Malayan Colleges Laguna (MMCL) and Mapúa Malayan Colleges Mindanao (MMCM), welcomed 788 junior and senior high school STEM teachers from across the Philippines to its flagship continuing professional development event – STEM Teach Mapúa 2024. Held from July 6 to August 3, 2024, the event was endorsed by the Philippine Department of Education and recognized by the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC).

news.title: Mapúa University Hosts Alumni and Industry Curriculum Summit 2024
news.content_introduction: Mapúa University took a significant step towards bridging the skills gap and preparing students for the dynamic job market with its inaugural Alumni and Industry Curriculum Summit on July 13, 2024. Hosted by the Mapúa Institute for Lifelong Learning and Global Competencies and co-sponsored by the National Association of Mapúa Alumni, Inc. (NAMA) and Foundation of Outstanding Mapúans, Inc. (FOMI), the event brought together University administration, faculty, alumni, and industry experts to collaborate on developing T-shaped graduates.

news.title: Cisco Philippines and Mapúa University Unveil First-ever Digital Classrooms Equipped with New AI-Led Collaboration
news.content_introduction: Mapúa University, one of the top engineering and technological schools in the Philippines, today unveiled how it will leverage AI-led collaboration and connectivity tools to redefine the classroom experience for students in the upcoming academic year, beginning in August 2024.

news.title: Top 3 trendy college programs to pursue at Mapúa this 2024
news.content_introduction: Choosing a college degree can be overwhelming for just about anybody. To help speed up your decision-making, you might want to include these trendy degree programs Mapúa University recommended in your shortlist. blogs.title: Hospitality and Tourism Course in College: What to Look for in a Good Program
blogs.content_introduction:
A solid educational foundation is crucial to any career. Think of your bachelor’s degree as a toolkit for personal and professional growth. Without it, it would be difficult to rise above the ranks and set yourself apart from other candidates.

For many doors to open, particularly those leading to management positions and career advancement, a comprehensive background built upon a college degree in tourism, hospitality management, or a closely related field is often essential. Choosing the right hospitality and tourism course in college, let alone the right university, is one of the most important decisions you’ll make as you embark on the next chapter of your academic journey.

Don’t worry because we’re here to help you make an informed choice.

blogs.title: Hospitality and Tourism Jobs for Graduates
blogs.content_introduction:
If you’re passionate about travel, culture, and people, a job in hospitality and tourism is perfect for you. The industry tastefully combines these passions into a rewarding and well-paying career. Imagine waking up every day knowing your job could let you see new places and interact with people from different backgrounds. Sounds exciting, right? That’s the kind of dynamic, fast-paced, and fulfilling world that hospitality and tourism offers.

Let’s explore the hospitality and tourism jobs you can potentially pursue after college.

blogs.title: The Importance of Tourism and Hospitality Careers
blogs.content_introduction:
When we hear the term “tourism and hospitality,” we often think of hotels, restaurants, and flights. While it all seems like fun and leisure at face value, this industry actually plays a much bigger role in keeping a country's economy stable and helping it grow than you might initially think.

Take the Philippines, for example. Tourism and hospitality are absolutely vital for keeping local businesses going strong, providing tons of job opportunities for Filipinos, and making life better overall by offering enjoyable ways to relax and have fun. It's not just about showing people a good time; these sectors are about creating happiness, encouraging the sharing of different cultures, and really driving economic progress.

Let’s explore the importance of tourism and hospitality and why careers in this industry are essential to society.

blogs.title: Tourism and Hospitality: A Degree That Combines Passion, People, and Practicality
blogs.content_introduction:
Ever wondered what goes on behind the scenes when you check into your hotel, dine at your favorite restaurant, or visit breathtaking tourist spots? Your enjoyable and hassle-free travel experiences don’t just materialize out of thin air. They result from the skills and effort of professionals whose careers revolve around tourism and hospitality.

If you’re passionate about travel, curious about diverse cultures, and thrive around people, a degree in hospitality and tourism could be your perfect match.

blogs.title: From Solar Power to Smart Cities: Career Paths in Sustainable Infrastructure
blogs.content_introduction:
Imagine building cities that breathe, roads that generate power, and communities that thrive in harmony with nature. This isn’t science fiction—it’s the future of infrastructure. And it needs engineers who think beyond concrete and steel.

There has never been a more promising time to pursue sustainability engineer jobs or related sustainability jobs in the Philippines. As the nation aligns itself with global climate targets and sustainable development goals (SDGs), the demand for professionals who can lead the transition to eco-friendly infrastructure is exploding.

Welcome to the world of sustainable infrastructure. Here are 10 career paths that don’t just build structures—they build a better future.

blogs.title: How Studying Sustainability Prepares You for Jobs That Make an Impact
blogs.content_introduction: The climate crisis, rising energy demand, and environmental degradation are not just news headlines—they're urgent, real-world challenges that need bold, science-driven solutions. And at the heart of these solutions is a field designed to create real, lasting change: environmental and energy engineering.

blogs.title: Engineering and Sustainability: From Smart Materials to Carbon-Neutral Buildings
blogs.content_introduction:
Sustainability is no longer a mere aspiration—it is an imperative. As climate change intensifies and global resources become increasingly strained, the role of engineers in crafting viable, forward-thinking solutions has never been more critical. Engineers today are not only builders of infrastructure but also proponents of sustainability trends—they are architects of systemic transformation, driving the shift toward a more sustainable and resilient future. 

Innovations such as self-healing smart materials and carbon-neutral buildings that dynamically respond to their environments are redefining the boundaries of possibility. These technological advancements are not projections of the future—they are unfolding now, engineered with precision and purpose.

blogs.title: How Engineers are Making Sustainability Happen for a Greener Future
blogs.content_introduction:
As the world confronts environmental changes, dwindling natural resources, and rising pollution, it has become clear that the need for sustainable solutions has never been more urgent. Sustainability engineering is at the heart of the global transformation we need to secure our future. 

Engineers are no longer just building infrastructure; they’re designing the future. From creating smarter energy systems to designing greener cities, they’re behind every step we take, closer to a more sustainable world. 

This article explores how engineers build a greener future, what sustainability in engineering truly means, and how Mapúa University prepares the next generation of sustainability warriors.

blogs.title: The Importance of Multimedia Arts in Social Media, Advertising, and Branding
blogs.content_introduction:
Multimedia arts are all around us—on your social media feed, in the ads you scroll past, and even in the way brands tell their stories online. It’s the heartbeat of the digital world, closely tied to technology and the internet we use every day.

If you love design and all things digital, understanding the importance of multimedia arts is a fundamental requirement. Discover how multimedia arts is changing the game in the fields of social media, advertising, and branding.

blogs.title: Multimedia Arts Jobs You Can Pursue After College
blogs.content_introduction:
Multimedia arts is a relatively new field, and when people hear of it, they typically think it’s all about drawing or designing. However, multimedia arts is more than that. It covers various art forms, from video editing and animation to web design and sound engineering. This discipline allows artists to tell stories and bring ideas to life through visuals, sound, and motion.

While that all sounds interesting, a passion for multimedia arts can also become a profession. Knowing which career paths are open to you can help you in future employment. Let’s explore what exciting multimedia arts jobs are waiting for graduates after college.

blogs.title: Multimedia Arts Subjects and Tools You’ll Master in College
blogs.content_introduction:
The digital age is booming, and multimedia artists are in high demand. If you’re passionate about art, design, storytelling, and technology, then this field might be right for you.
But before you become a full-fledged professional, a multimedia arts degree is essential to equip you with the skills and knowledge needed to create stunning and engaging visual content.

Search no further because Mapúa University will help you unlock your full potential as a multimedia artist in today’s creatives industry. Here are the subjects you can expect to learn in our Bachelor of Arts in Multimedia Arts program.

blogs.title: Why Multimedia Arts is a Top Choice for College Students
blogs.content_introduction:
In this day and age, digital experiences shape how we live, learn, and interact. Multimedia arts have emerged as one of the most in-demand and future-proof college courses. From graphic design and animation to video production, this industry seamlessly blends creativity and technology for impactful storytelling. 

The best part? Multimedia arts are far from slowing down, even with AI-generated art coming into the picture. You can never fully replace a real artist’s skill and attention to detail. With businesses, brands, and creators constantly seeking new ways to engage audiences online, the opportunities for multimedia artists continue to expand.

Ready to discover if multimedia arts is the right path for you in college?

blogs.title: Why Data Science is Important in Business, Healthcare, Entertainment, and Other Industries
blogs.content_introduction:
Although data science is a field of science and technology, its applications and impact reach out far and wide. From businesses and governments to healthcare institutions and energy companies, organizations are harnessing data science to gain insights and improve their operations.

If you’re already interested in data science, it might help seal the deal by learning what is the importance of data science in different industries. Keep reading because this is what we’ll dive into in this article.

blogs.title: Math, Coding, and More: What to Expect in a Data Science Course
blogs.content_introduction:
With data becoming one of the most valuable resources today, there is a growing demand for data science graduates. They can establish meaningful careers in businesses, governments, healthcare institutions, and tech companies.

But what can aspiring data scientists expect from their chosen course? In this blog, we'll discuss the data science subjects you can expect in college.

blogs.title: What Can You Do with a Data Science Degree? Career Paths Explained
blogs.content_introduction: As more organizations embrace digital transformation, data has become the new currency—valuable, powerful, and essential to decision-making across all industries. This comes with the demand for professionals who can collect, interpret, and leverage data has grown significantly, ensuring a wide array of data science jobs in the Philippines and around the globe.

blogs.title: Data Science Degree 101: What It Is and Why It’s a Great Career Choice
blogs.content_introduction: The data science course is among the most challenging yet rewarding fields in the Philippines and today's world. It combines mathematics, statistics, and computer programming, allowing data scientists to use data to improve decision-making.

blogs.title: Reasons to Choose Mapúa Graduate School
blogs.content_introduction: Working while in grad school can be challenging, but choosing the right institution for your postgraduate studies can make all the difference. Mapúa University, renowned for its excellence in engineering, information technology, business, and other fields, offers graduate programs designed to equip students with the skills and knowledge needed to excel in their careers. No matter your personal and professional goals, Mapúa graduate school will set you up for success.

blogs.title: How to Balance Working While in Grad School
blogs.content_introduction: If your heart is set on pursuing a master’s degree, the next important decision is whether to quit your job so you can focus on graduate school. The demands of a full-time career and the rigors of higher education can be a tricky balancing act. However, it’s entirely possible to manage both. While it can be challenging to keep working while in graduate school, the right mindset and habits will lead you to success.

blogs.title: Reasons for Choosing a Graduate School for Your Career Goals
blogs.content_introduction:
If you’ve already been working for years, perhaps you’re now thinking about the next step in your career. Investing in a master’s degree can be a game-changer and lead you to better job opportunities, higher earning potential, and enhanced credibility. But with so many options out there, how do you choose the graduate school that aligns with your career goals?

Let’s explore why furthering your education can be a smart move and things to consider when choosing a school.

blogs.title: Is Graduate School Worth It? The Benefits of an Advanced Degree
blogs.content_introduction:
Have you been working for a few years and contemplating what’s next for your career? Maybe you’re eyeing a leadership role, but the qualifications call for more experience. Perhaps you’re considering switching industries, but your current skill set isn’t enough. Or maybe you want something new and exciting in your life.

If you’re having these thoughts, don’t worry. You’re not alone. Many working professionals grapple with this decision and think getting a master’s degree is the solution. But is it really worth it?

Let’s explore the benefits of an advanced degree and whether it’s a worthwhile investment for your career and personal growth.

blogs.title: Must-Have Game Developer Skills for the Modern Gaming Industry
blogs.content_introduction:
Ever thought about what it takes to make a game, not just play one? Whether you’re hooked on Mobile Legends, can’t get enough of indie games on Steam, or grew up on classics like Ragnarok, you’ve probably wondered how these games come to life. Behind every fun, addictive game is a team of game developers with skills that go way beyond just knowing how to play.

If you’re serious about breaking into the gaming industry and building a career in game development, you’ll need a solid set of game developer skills—technical, creative, and everything in between. Let’s talk about what those are and how you can develop them.

blogs.title: The Rise of Esports and How It Shapes the Gaming Industry
blogs.content_introduction:
Have you ever beamed with joy after clutching a round when you’re the only player alive? Or have you ever been under tremendous pressure to help your team pull off a miraculous comeback and win the game? These are the feelings players experience when they play competitive video games. And as many become more passionate about these intense moments, what was once just a hobby has evolved into something bigger—the rise of esports.

In the Philippines, esports has grown from small internet café tournaments to packed arenas and global competitions streamed to millions. It’s now a booming industry shaping careers, inspiring young gamers, and putting the country on the map in the international gaming scene. Esports has not only created new opportunities for professional players but has also fueled growth across the entire gaming industry.

In this blog, we’ll explore how the rise of esports shapes the gaming industry in the 
Philippines.

blogs.title: 9 Roles in Game Development to Consider
blogs.content_introduction:
If you love playing video games, you’ve probably thought about what it would be like to create one. Maybe you’ve imagined designing a new game level, programming characters to move, or crafting a story that players can’t stop thinking about. The gaming industry offers many different game development roles for people of all kinds of talents.

As an incoming college student, you’re at the perfect stage to think about which path in game development fits you best. The Philippine gaming industry is growing, from mobile games to console and PC projects. Local studios and international companies are looking for talented Filipinos who are passionate about games and want to be part of the development process.

So, where do you start? Let’s explore the different roles in game development to help you find the one that suits your skills and interests.

blogs.title: From Gamer to Game Developer: Build Your Future in Game Development
blogs.content_introduction:
You’re sitting in front of your screen, fingers flying over the controller or keyboard, locked in an epic battle, puzzle, or quest. The hours melt away as you explore worlds, uncover stories, and master gameplay mechanics. But have you ever found yourself wondering, “What if I could be the one making games like this? What if I could create something players around the world would love?” 

That’s where game development comes in.

blogs.title: How Attending Senior High School Online Sets You Up for Success
blogs.content_introduction:
The demands of higher education and the modern workplace require a holistic approach to learning, one that extends beyond academic achievement. Online senior high school provides a flexible and innovative pathway to developing the skills, knowledge, and mindset necessary for success. 

But how exactly does an online senior high program prepare students for the challenges and opportunities that lie ahead?

blogs.title: How Online Graduate Schools are Opening More Doors for Professionals
blogs.content_introduction:
Choosing the right post-graduate program is a life-altering decision. Think about your individual circumstances, learning style, and career goals. Do you thrive in a self-directed learning environment? Do you need the flexibility that online learning provides? Are you comfortable using online communication tools and collaborating with peers in a virtual setting? These are important questions to ask yourself when deciding whether going for an online post-grad school is the right fit for you.

If you're considering an online graduate school in the Philippines, research is key. Look for accredited institutions with a proven track record in online education. Consider the program's curriculum, faculty expertise, and student support services. A reputable online graduate school will provide a comprehensive learning experience, comparable to its on-campus programs.

blogs.title: Is Getting a College Degree Online a Good Idea?
blogs.content_introduction:
Choosing the right path to a college degree is a significant investment in your future. With the growing prevalence of online learning, a common question among incoming students is: Can an online college degree provide a quality education? 

Let's delve into the essential elements of online undergraduate degrees and address some frequently asked questions!

blogs.title: Online Learning: How It’s a Game Changer in Education
blogs.content_introduction:
Education, as we once knew, is going through a significant transition—shifting from traditional, often rigid structures to more flexible and accessible modalities. Online learning, once a supplementary option, has become a core and increasingly vital part of acquiring knowledge and skills. It empowers individuals, giving them control over their education, regardless of location, schedule, or prior circumstances.

But what is online learning, and why is it quickly becoming the future of education, especially for aspiring business professionals? Let's find out together!

blogs.title: Choosing a School That Helps You Balance Academic and Social Life
blogs.content_introduction:
The best universities recognize the importance of balancing academic and social life. After all, a meaningful college experience is more than just about coursework. It’s also about the connections you gain along the way.

Choosing a school that helps you successfully balance academic and social life is a sure step in developing both your intellectual and personal facets – a recipe for well-rounded growth. To achieve this, schools should ideally offer structured academic programs, a variety of extracurricular activities, and a thriving campus community. 

If you’re unsure about what factors to look for in a school, then keep reading.

blogs.title: Picking a University Based on the Learning Style of Students
blogs.content_introduction:
Every student has a unique way of absorbing and retaining information. Some thrive in structured lecture-based settings, while others learn best through hands-on experience. Understanding the learning styles of students is a key point to consider when choosing a university. This is because it ensures you select an institution that complements your educational needs.

Higher learning is difficult, and whether you’re enrolling in an engineering school or a business school, your student learning style will impact your academic success and future career prospects. If you’re still not sure how this affects your future, we’ll answer all this by the end.

blogs.title: Choosing a University Based on Your Career Goals: What You Need to Know
blogs.content_introduction:
As a student, you may think that your career choices only begin once you join the job market. However, that couldn't be further from the truth. Your career journey starts the moment you choose a university.

Choosing a school that’s right for you lays the foundation for your career. This is because your time in college will give you the education, training, and opportunities you need to succeed. If you’re in the middle of considering schools, understanding how the institution you choose impacts your career path is key.

blogs.title: How Exploring Multiple Universities Can Lead to the Best Opportunities
blogs.content_introduction:
Choosing a school will set the tone for your future. Wherever it is you’ll go will play a role in the jobs you’ll get and the network you’ll cultivate. 

If you’re looking to pursue higher education locally, the Philippines is home to many academically competitive universities. You’ll have an abundance of options to choose from with unparalleled opportunities behind each one - which can also be paralyzing.

blogs.title: Senior High School Strands in the PH: a Brief Overview of the Academic Track
blogs.content_introduction:
The K-12 is an educational system implemented by the Department of Education (DepEd) that is designed to equip students like you with the necessary skills and knowledge to achieve your academic and professional goals—whether that’s higher education, entrepreneurship, or employment. A key component of the K-12 program is the Senior High School (SHS) level, where students specialize in a particular track or strand.

If you’re unsure what to take, read on to learn more about the senior high school strands in the Philippines under the Academic Track.

blogs.title: What to Look for When Choosing a College in Manila
blogs.content_introduction:
Are you about to embark on your higher education journey? If so, you might find yourself at a crossroads. The school you choose will play a vital role in shaping your future. And if you’re considering studying in Manila where options abound, the decision can feel overwhelming. 

Don’t worry because this guide can help make choosing a college easier. Keep reading to learn more.

blogs.title: Factors to Consider in Choosing the Best School for Architecture in Manila
blogs.content_introduction: For aspiring architects like you, one of the most critical decisions you need to make before beginning your journey is choosing the right school to attend. Your higher education lays the foundation for your forthcoming competencies and future job opportunities, so it’s crucial to identify the institution that will build you for success.

blogs.title: How to Be a Mapúan Scholar and Maintain Your Scholarship
blogs.content_introduction: Education opens doors to a world of possibilities, and there are incredible resources available to support students on their academic journey. Scholarships help make quality education more accessible, giving equal opportunity for people from all walks of life to thrive.
